scope: Legacy shard loading and execution shape preflight
behavior: Restore ModelConfig from required sibling header instead of constructing zero defaults
Bound file reads, counts and decoder slices; reject truncated, oversized, invalid-version/UTF8/range/trailing content
Require positive embedding width and exact RMSNorm/Q dimensions before file/network admission or execution
Reject malformed upload without replacing existing shard or poisoning shared state; invalid BatchRequest closes session
Execution visits only represented RMSNorm/Q layers in ascending order, preserving first-duplicate semantics; empty declared ranges up to u32::MAX do not induce a linear layer walk
limitations: RPN file decoding is structural, not graph semantic validation.
The legacy executor remains RMSNorm/Q-only, not causal transformer inference.
File shards now require the sibling header that the serializer already writes.
The 512MiB file cap is not a peak-RSS cap: input bytes and decoded weights coexist. Serializer output exceeding the cap is rejected.
